import pandas as pd
import csv

# Read input data from long-format CSV
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv')

# Pivot to wide format: each indicator_id becomes a column
# Index columns: city_id, city_name, year

pivot_df = df.pivot_table(
    index=['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'],
    columns='indicator_id',
    values='value',
    aggfunc='first'
)

# Reset index to make identifier columns regular columns
pivot_df = pivot_df.reset_index()

pivot_df.to_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv', index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_ALL)
